content.Indications for ICD: Consider ICD implantation if: family history of sudden cardiac death in one or more first degree relatives under 40 years of age or sudden cardiac death in a first degree relative with confirmed HCM at any age; NSVT; unexplained syncope.
content.Amyloidosis: See referenced sections for details (section 14.6 and Figure 21).
content.Abbreviations and gene notes (excerpt): AV = atrio-ventricular; BAG3 = Bcl2-associated athanogene 3; ECG = electrocardiogram; HCM = hypertrophic cardiomyopathy; ICD = implantable cardioverter-defibrillator; LGE = late gadolinium enhancement; LMNA = lamin A/C; LV = left ventricular; LVEF = left ventricular ejection fraction; LVOT = left ventricular outflow tract; LVOTO = left ventricular outflow tract obstruction; MHC = myosin heavy chain; MYPC (myosin-binding protein C); NSVT = non-sustained ventricular tachycardia; NYHA = New York Heart Association; OMT = optimal medical therapy; PLN = phospholamban; RBM20 = RNA binding motif 20; RV = right ventricular; TNNT = troponin-T; TTN = titin.
content.Note on genes: The list of genes is not exhaustive and will change over time; contact the genetic department for current core panels.
content.Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy - Definiti: Inherited heart muscle disease characterized by progressive fibrofatty replacement of the RV myocardium which may act as a substrate for ventricular arrhythmias, unexplained syncope and/or sudden cardiac death. LV involvement and systolic dysfunction occurs in >30% of AC patients; phenotype may overlap with DCM.
content.Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy - Diagnosi: Based upon evaluation of combination of genetic factors (most cases autosomal dominant desmosomal mutations), documentation of ventricular arrhythmias and imaging criteria (echocardiography and MRI) of RV dysplasia with fibrofatty replacement either or not confirmed by EMB. Specific ECG abnormalities can be present or absent.
